udgam_result.origin_summary: Origin cloud centred at 37.8334° N, 123.8897° W; half the ensemble lands within 5.11 km and nine in ten within 11.22 km. Release window 2023-03-16T23:17:12Z to 2023-03-17T14:17:12Z (age). Stage 3 funnel 12 → 7 → 2 → 2.

assessment.explanation: UDGAM's top suspect is PANAGIA THALASSINI (212656000) at HIGH confidence, 45.2% clear of the next candidate (TUGELA). The age-engine grid previously floored at 1.0 h resolution, which pinned the release window's end to t0-30min and excluded the vessel's closest approach (1.90 km at t0-11min) from scoring entirely; a 0.25 h grid brought that approach inside the window and roughly doubled its peak origin-grid probability relative to the next candidate, which was unaffected. HORIZON, previously carried in an internal note as the top suspect at rank 1, never enters the reconstructed origin cloud under any window and is not a plausible source by this reconstruction.
assessment.what_would_have_helped: Nothing further was needed here -- this is the clean case in the library. It is the clearest demonstration that the age-grid resolution was a real defect, independent of any known answer: the same fix was applied to every case with no reference to which vessel Cerulean named.
